scoring_justification: The ΔE values are computed by DFT; the verifier cannot rerun the full DFT, so we compare the agent's reported ΔE to the paper's hidden gold with tolerance and enforce the expected trend.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold ΔE values (meV/atom) for Li2VO2F, Li2V0.5Ti0.5O2F, Li2V0.5Fe0.5O2F
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Extracted from the paper: text reports 179, 144, 147 meV/atom.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Paper headline numerical results; the reference solution solve.sh hardcodes them.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's actual reported numbers.

outputs.description: Ordering propensity ΔE values (meV/atom) for the three compositions, defined as the difference between the total energy of the SQS and the lowest-energy ordered prototype.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares the three ΔE values to the paper's reported numbers with an absolute tolerance and enforces a relative trend condition: the substituted compounds must be at least 20 meV/atom lower than the unsubstituted compound.

trend.description: Both substituted compounds must have ΔE at least 20 meV/atom lower than Li2VO2F
